title: Clean Up, Please: exercises
subtitle: Five exercises on the text
label: Exercises
review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the English and the answers before using it with learners.

items.q: Mom tells Mia to clean up.
Mia puts her books in the box.
Mia puts the blocks in the box.
Mia puts her crayons on the bed.
At the end, the room is still messy.
What does Mom say at the end?

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: Mia's room needs cleaning. She picks up her toys and puts her books, blocks and crayons in their places. At the end, the room is all clean, and Mom says, "Good job!"

items.q: What does Mia put on the shelf?
What does Mia put in the box?
What does Mom say at the end?
How do you help clean at home?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the events in the order of the story.
items: Mia puts her books on the shelf
Mia puts the blocks in the box
Mia puts her crayons on the table
